name: Pranay Anchuri
description: Pranay Anchuri is a Senior Research Scientist at Offchain Labs. His research spans blockchain protocols, verifiable computation, and machine learning applied to decentralized systems. He has published at top venues including KDD, JMLR, and ICDM, and is an inventor on seven US patents. He holds a PhD in Computer Science from Rensselaer Polytechnic Institute.
